newsitem.title: USA: American Greetings reports record profits.
newsitem.headline: American Greetings reports record profits.

text.p: American Greetings Corp. Thursday reported record earnings for the latest quarter, thanks to a gain of more than 10 percent in sales.

The nation's second-largest card maker said it earned $74.6 million, or $1.00 a share, in its fiscal third quarter ended on Nov. 30, compared with year-ago income of $17.4 million, or 24 cents a share. Sales jumped to $647.8 million from $587.7 million.
American Greetings said its results were boosted by the company's strategy to ship cards, gift wrap and other seasonal products closer to the time they actually are needed by retailers.

"We anticipated this shift and our third-quarter results indicate that we are on track," said Morry Weiss, chairman and chief executive officer. "We expect that this shifting will have a positive effect on our fourth-quarter results as well."
The company said its U.S. Greeting Card division had strong results, while its Canadian operations continued to be impacted by that country's sluggish economy.
Kansas City, Mo.-based Hallmark Cards Inc., is the largest card maker.
American Greetings' stock was up 37.5 cents at $27.50 in early trading on the Nasdaq market.
